description: Hooks that have been used, with measured performance. The learning agent scales, reworks, archives, or kills a hook based on this record.

learning_thresholds.note: At the spec's daily targets this system produces 30-60 measurable items per month. Acting on a single data point would be chasing noise. A hook is not classified until it clears BOTH thresholds, and performance is judged against the rolling median for its platform, not an absolute cutoff. See CLAUDE.md addendum A5.
